signals.summary: 2025 restructuring across Diagnostics, Nutritionals, Established Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices booked $274M in severance and other charges.
Restructuring accrual fell to $104M by June 30, 2026 from $180M at end of 2025 after payments and adjustments.
Abbott closed its acquisition of Exact Sciences, adding the company's staff to its workforce.
Abbott's March 2026 release counted 122,000 colleagues after the Exact Sciences acquisition closed.
October 2025 redundancy process at the Galway rapid diagnostics site affected fewer than 20 people.
Around 70 staff at the Sligo and Longford plants were reported affected by redundancies being offered.
